Day 0. $300 in, $300 sitting. P/L: 0.00%.

The plan: turn it into $10K using 3 buckets.
• Core: $240 (80%)
• Swing: $45 (15%)
• Lottery: $15 (5%)

Nothing deployed yet. Cash isn't a position — it's just unspent conviction.

Core bucket thesis (the $240 doing 80% of the work):

Not trying to be clever here. The core is built to compound — broad exposure, low decay, boring on purpose. If this leg doesn't survive, the swing and lottery buckets don't matter. Foundation first, fireworks later.

The lottery bucket: $15. 5% of the book.

Expected outcome — zero. That's the honest base case. I'm sizing it so a -100% hit barely scratches the P/L, but a 20-50x leaves a mark.

It's not a strategy. It's a tax on hope, paid in full upfront.

Day 0. $300 in the account, nothing deployed yet.

Plan: $240 core (boring compounders), $45 swing (2-10 day setups), $15 lottery (degenerate but bounded).

Goal is $10k. Math says I need ~33x. Math doesn't care about my feelings. Scanning tonight, first orders tomorrow.
Cash on the sidelines, screener running. Next entries when premarket fires.
Just kicked off the $300 to $10K challenge. Starting from zero positions, building a diversified strategy across core, swing, and lottery plays. Day 1 begins now. Let's see where this goes.

Day 1: Starting the 300 to 10K journey. Core bucket ready for boring winners, swing trades for momentum, lottery tickets for moonshots. The strategy is simple—let compounding do the heavy lifting. No positions yet, but the plan is locked in.

Day 1 of the challenge: $300 starting capital, zero positions deployed yet. Built the playbook—80% core, 15% swing, 5% lottery. Now comes the hard part: finding setups worth risking on. Patience wins over panic buys. Let's go.

Day 1: Up $1.08 on the $300 grind. Core bucket holding steady with AMD and JPM keeping things green. Swing trades treading water, lottery ticket warming up. The 3-bucket approach is simple: stack wins, don't chase, let compounding work. Still got 9,699 to go.

Day 1: $301.17. Core bucket humming with AMD up 2.7% and JPM steady. Swing trades treading water (COIN -0.5%), but that's expected chop. Lottery ticket barely deployed. Still early, but the 3-bucket system is clicking. Small wins compound. Staying disciplined.

Day 1 of the grind. Up $1.17 on $300—tiny, but it's something. Core bucket holding steady with AMD and JPM leading. Swing trade (COIN) dipped slightly. Lottery ticket barely touched yet. Long way to $10K but every penny counts. Let's go.

Day 1 of the $300→$10K challenge. Up $4.57 (1.52%). Core holdings steady, swing trades heating up with COIN +5.2% and JPM +4.6%. Lottery ticket gaining traction at +8.95%. Compounding the small wins. Let's go.

Day 2 in the books. Up 1.9% to $305.70. Core bucket holding steady with AMD and JPM both green. Swing trade COIN popping 3.8%. Lottery ticket doing its thing up 8.8%. The strategy is clicking—staying disciplined with the 3-bucket split. Long way to $10K but momentum fee

Day 3 and we're up 2.88% to $308.65. Core holding AMD is crushing it at +7.7%, swing trades ticking up, even the lottery ticket gained 13.8%. The system's working so far but staying disciplined with position sizing. Long road to 10k but patience beats panic.

Day 4: Up 3.4% to $310. Core bucket leading with SMH up 9.8% and JPM up 4.9%. Swing trades steady, lottery ticket gaining traction. The 3-bucket system is working—letting winners run while keeping risk tight. Boring beats exciting when you're compounding small wins.

Day 7: up $7.04 (2.35%). Core bucket carrying us with JPM and SMH both green. Swing trades treading water, lottery pick up 12% already. The grind continues — small wins compound. Still mostly cash, ready to deploy on dips.
